name: peer-review-agents
description: Run an evidence-linked peer review of a manuscript PDF from Codex.

interface.longDescription: Review a local manuscript PDF with the PeerReviewAgents engine: independent reviewers investigate the imported sources with bounded tools, an audited debate synthesizes their findings, and every finding is anchored to an exact quotation. Monitor the run and read its REVIEW.md.
defaultPrompt: Review this manuscript PDF with Peer Review Agents.
Check the status of my peer review.
Read REVIEW.md from my completed review.
